problem_statement: The current WP507 deterministic contract can distinguish offered/delivered/uptaken caller-supplied evidence and matched contract-scope output differences, but actual model-runtime GWT uptake and hidden-state causality remain unproven. Parallel Trigger-6 work has already mapped multiple intervention, causal-analysis, eval and observability tools. The resource-saving question is which minimum subset can add new evidence rather than duplicate machinery.
observed_constraints: Current supervisor keeps all provider routes unadmitted and actual WP507 runtime uptake false.
WP507 G3 explicitly does not observe hidden model state and grants zero runtime/GWT/J-Space credit from deterministic contract tests.
No accepted exact local target-model/J-Space intervention ABI is currently bound to the researched NNsight/pyvene/TransformerLens candidates.
Existing Trigger-6 source archaeology already identifies native PyTorch module hooks as the lowest-extra-dependency intervention baseline.
PyTorch module-specific forward hooks can observe and replace module outputs and return a removable handle; global hooks add global state and are therefore not the preferred F2 baseline.
NNsight provides richer tracing/interleaving and activation intervention over PyTorch models, but adds nontrivial tracing/runtime and dependency surface.
pyvene provides explicit intervention semantics and richer lesion/swap/noise/trainable controls but has a broad scientific/Transformers dependency surface and model-component mapping risk.
TransformerLens provides strong activation-cache/patching machinery but can require architecture conversion/bridge fidelity and exact target compatibility remains unresolved in the audited evidence.

live_f2_core_now.reason: Without an admitted exact real model/runtime path, another library cannot promote actual uptake evidence and would increase dependency/maintenance surface. Keep WP507 as the deterministic causal/provenance contract.

first_model_internal_falsifier_when_exac.reason: Lowest extra dependency, preserves ownership of the already-loaded model object, supports activation observation/replacement, removable lifecycle and direct fail-closed binding to F2 event/generation/vector identities.
forbid: global module hooks as the default because they add global state
treating hook output as canonical truth
using hook registration as loader consumed-byte attestation
claiming uptake from output change without sham/random/equal-norm controls and rescue

conditional_second_choice.promotion_condition: Only if an exact target-model E3/E4 comparison shows materially better deterministic intervention ergonomics, coverage or reproducibility than native hooks at acceptable latency/RSS/VRAM/dependency cost.
conditional_second_choice.reason: It can wrap an existing PyTorch model and offers structured tracing/interleaving, but current source evidence does not justify paying that complexity before the native baseline fails.

defer_heavier_frameworks.reason: Richer intervention catalog is useful only after exact model/J-Space ABI and when native/NNsight coverage is insufficient; current dependency and architecture-mapping surface is too heavy for WP507 core.
Strong mechanistic-interpretability features do not outweigh conversion/compatibility risk for the current blocker.

supporting_noncore_tools.decision: WITNESS/PROVENANCE_ONLY; NOT COGNITIVE_TRUTH OR CAUSALITY AUTHORITY

hypothesis.statement: For the first exact local ~0.8B F2/J-Space causal-uptake experiment, a thin module-specific native PyTorch hook harness plus existing F2 causal/provenance receipts will produce the highest information gain per dependency/resource cost. NNsight/pyvene/TransformerLens should remain optional research adapters until they beat this baseline on the exact target model.
hypothesis.falsifier: On the exact source-pinned local target model and fixed intervention workload, native hooks fail required intervention coverage, reproducibility or provenance-safe rescue while a pinned alternative succeeds with acceptable measured latency/RAM/VRAM/dependency cost.

counterhypotheses.statement: NNsight's structured trace/interleaver substantially reduces experiment brittleness and provenance mistakes enough to justify its added dependency surface.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Matched exact-model native-hooks vs NNsight collect/zero/swap/rescue fixture with identical input, target module, seeds, output checks and F2 causal identities.

counterhypotheses.statement: The actual target runtime is not hook-visible PyTorch eager execution, making the native-hook path invalid.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Bind exact loader/runtime/build identity first and mechanically prove the declared intervention point fires and can be removed without changing the baseline.

counterhypotheses.statement: Any model-internal intervention is the wrong layer for proving F2 GWT uptake; only black-box matched broadcasts and downstream behavior are scientifically admissible.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Run cross-layer pre-registered intervention/control/rescue where software-level WP507 receipts remain independently satisfied and internal-target perturbation has specific reversible effects beyond sham/random controls.

preconditions: exact local target model checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build identity
loader consumed-byte attestation or equivalent exact loaded-artifact identity
declared stable module/vector intervention ABI tied to F2 causal event/generation identities
experiment: rescue restoring the pre-registered target activation
repeat with hook removed to prove reversibility and no stale hook state
measure deterministic output digest plus p50/p95 latency, CPU/RSS and GPU/VRAM if present
next_exact_gate.promotion_rule: Native hooks become the research harness baseline only after E3 exact-target execution. NNsight becomes an E5 candidate only after an E4 head-to-head net-benefit result.

PyTorch stable global register_module_forward_hook documentation warns that it adds global state and is intended for debugging/profiling.
NNsight current documentation describes tracing/interleaving for model execution and interventions.
